name: PdxPageHeader
description:
The standard header of a page: a breadcrumb, the title with an optional subtitle, and an area for
the page's actions.

members.name: headingLevel
members.description: The title's heading level, 1-6. Default 1; lower it for a header inside a dialog or a section.

events.name: pdx-crumb
events.description: A crumb with a link was chosen: its `key` and the crumb.

attributes.name: headinglevel
attributes.description: The title's heading level, 1-6. Default 1; lower it for a header inside a dialog or a section.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Commands shown in the header's actions area (e.g. the page's primary action).

cssParts.name: breadcrumb
cssParts.description: The `<nav>` of the crumbs, when there are any.

cssParts.name: subtitle
cssParts.description: The line under the title, when there is one.

cssParts.name: actions
cssParts.description: The area the `actions` slot lands in.
